title: YaRN: Efficient Context Window Extension of Large Language Models
selection_reason: YaRN extends context windows for RoPE-based LLMs. The paper states that Dynamic Scaling updates the positional-embedding scale on each inference pass, and that the rotary embeddings have zero added overhead; it demonstrates extended LLaMA context lengths up to 64K and 128K. This is an inference-time long-context method, even though some YaRN variants also use limited fine-tuning.
